papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.summary: A multi-layer indexer reuses adjacent layers’ token selections to overlap indexer scans with attention, improving long-context decode throughput when combined with cross-layer indexer reuse while maintaining accuracy.

papers.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
papers.summary: Halley is a predictive control framework for AI data center optical networks that improves effective throughput and reduces capacity needs by forecasting failures and controlling resources with formal guarantees.

papers.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
papers.summary: TaoMate-HD is an autoregressive streaming model that generates high-resolution audiovisual content in chunks with progressive denoising, history-based continuation, and optimized parallel deployment for faster, coherent long-form output.

papers.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
papers.summary: A four-parameter analytical law predicts LLM inference energy across architectures, revealing quadratic prefill costs, GQA savings, and super-linear growth from reasoning budgets and agentic serving.

papers.title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
papers.summary: HERIT adapts machine translation to historical archives via retrieval-augmented pseudo-labeling, improving accuracy across time periods and unlocking global access.
